messages:
DeployBot: Deploy started: inference-worker v2.3.4 -> prod-eu (canary subset). CI deploy id=deploy-2142, strategy=rolling, canary=10%
Priya (oncall): alerted by SLOs — elevated 5xx error rate on inference route. seeing ~6% errors from the new pods, latency spikes for some requests. paging P0.
Jordan M.: I can see crashlooping init sidecars on the new replicas. pods: inference-worker-abcde-1/Init:0 CrashLoopBackOff. grabbing logs now.
Sam K.: logs from init container: ```
2026-03-15T10:13:02Z ERROR: failed to run pre-start migration: ERROR: relation "replica_schema.table_x" does not exist
ExitCode=1
```
Priya (oncall): that init tries to run a migration against read-replicas — we should never run migrations from canary. looks like the new image accidentally has MIGRATION_RUN=on in the sidecar. that's the bad manifest.
Jordan M.: confirmed the manifest for v2.3.4 includes sidecar.env.MIGRATION_RUN=true. someone accidentally flipped the var during the release. this triggers write attempts against replicas and leads to DB connection errors which make readiness probes fail -> crashloop.
InfraBot: Node drain event started by CI: rolling node maintenance on ip-10-2-45-7 at 10:12:40Z.
Sam K.: that node drain overlapped with canary placement — several new pods landed on the draining node and failed init. combination of bad env + drain caused cascading failures.
Priya (oncall): impact: ~3% of production requests returned 500, some customers in EU saw higher error rates; no data loss detected but elevated DB error logs. marking customer impact: partial degradation.
Jordan M.: mitigation plan: 1) stop canary rollout (kill the canary subset), 2) flip feature flag to route around new sidecar if possible, 3) rollback to v2.3.3 if needed. who can abort the rollout?
Sam K.: I can abort the deployment. running: ```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/inference-worker --to-revision=2141 || kubectl scale deploy/inference-worker --replicas=0 --selector=canary=true
```
Sam K.: executed rollout undo -> returned: "deployment.apps/inference-worker rolled back to revision 2141". watching replicaSet.
Priya (oncall): Jordan, can you flip flag "enable_new_sidecar" -> false in flags service? that will stop traffic to new behavior.
Jordan M.: flag toggled to OFF at 10:18Z. Confirmed no further attempts to run migrations from sidecar.
InfraBot: Kubernetes: rollout undo observed. New pods from rev2141 becoming Ready.
Sam K.: readiness improving. removing remaining crashloop pods: ```bash
kubectl delete pod inference-worker-abcde-1 -n inference --force --grace-period=0
```
Elena S.: I'm taking over on-call from Priya for post-mortem and customer comms. Priya handing off — summary?
Priya (oncall): Handoff: root cause = env var (MIGRATION_RUN=true) accidentally baked into sidecar image/manifest for v2.3.4 + coincident node drain placed bad pods on the draining node causing init crashes and readiness fails. Immediate mitigation: rollback to v2.3.3 and flip feature flag. Impact: partial degradation, ~3% of requests 500, no data-loss. Next steps: pin CI to prevent env drift, add deploy time check to block migrations in canary, and add a pre-start guard that prevents sidecar migration against read-replicas. Assigned: Jordan for flag guard, Sam for deploy pipeline fix, Elena for postmortem doc and customer notes.
Jordan M.: I pushed a hotfix to feature-flags service to validate environment keys at flag flip and added an allowlist to prevent MIGRATION_RUN=true in canary manifests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/flags/pull/789
Sam K.: opened PR to CI deploy job to ensure sidecar env vars are validated against the deploy profile (canary vs primary) — https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy/pull/1024. also added a one-time migration gate to prevent migrations during canary.
Priya (oncall): PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged, severity P1 -> downgraded to P2 after rollback and error rate stabilised.
Elena S.: I'll draft customer-facing note and postmortem, assigning followups in the postmortem template. tagging @support for queued customer communications.
Priya (oncall): closing immediate incident channel. please add any residual logs or followups here. thanks everyone for fast response :thumbsup:
